mapper.select: select * from ai_llm_model where model_type = #{modelType} and is_default = true and enabled = true limit 1
mapper.update: update ai_llm_model set total_calls = total_calls + 1, total_tokens = total_tokens + #{tokenIncrement}, total_cost = total_cost + #{costIncrement}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}

update.foreach: update ai_llm_model set total_calls = total_calls + #{item.callCount}, total_tokens = total_tokens + #{item.tokenCount}, total_cost = total_cost + #{item.cost}, updated_at = now() where id = #{item.id}

mapper.select: select provider, model_type, count(*) as count from ai_llm_model where enabled = true group by provider, model_type
